questions.why: ㄱ만 틀렸다. every+단수명사는 단수 취급이므로 was가 되어야 한다. ㄷ은 분수 표현 뒤의 pizza가 단수이므로 was가 맞는다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은? ㄱ. Each of the students in the club pay a small fee. ㄴ. Most of the fruit in the basket is fresh. ㄷ. Some of the visitors from Japan speaks Korean well.
questions.why: ㄱ은 each가 주어라 pays, ㄷ은 visitors가 복수라 speak가 되어야 하므로 틀렸다. ㄴ은 fruit가 단수 취급이라 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. One of the students in my class come from Vietnam. ㄴ. Every road in the city was blocked by the snow. ㄷ. Most of the passengers were reading or sleeping. ㄹ. Each of the boxes contain ten books. ㅁ. Half of the class agrees with the plan.
questions.why: ㄴ, ㄷ, ㅁ(half of+단수명사 class)이 옳아 3개다. ㄱ은 comes, ㄹ은 contains가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Some of the ice on the road has melted. ㄴ. Every member of the band write their own songs. ㄷ. One of the easiest ways to relax is listening to music. ㄹ. Most of the shops on this street closes at nine. ㅁ. Each of the questions were worth five points.
questions.why: ㄱ(ice 단수 취급)과 ㄷ(one이 주어)만 옳아 2개다. ㄴ은 writes, ㄹ은 close, ㅁ은 was가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Half of the chairs in the hall was broken. ㄴ. Every child in the village knows the old song. ㄷ. Some of the money were stolen from the safe. ㄹ. One of the best players on the team is only fourteen. ㅁ. Most of the students in the survey want longer vacations.
questions.why: ㄱ(chairs 복수→were)과 ㄷ(money 단수 취급→was)이 틀려 2개다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Each of the countries in Asia has its own culture. ㄴ. About 30 percent of the students has a part-time job. ㄷ. Every bridge over the river were built long ago. ㄹ. Some of the cheese in the fridge smells strange. ㅁ. Most of my cousins lives in other cities.
questions.why: ㄱ과 ㄹ(cheese 단수 취급)만 옳아 2개다. ㄴ은 have, ㄷ은 was, ㅁ은 live가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. One of the lights in the hallway was still on. ㄴ. Every guest at the hotel receive a free breakfast. ㄷ. Half of the apples on the tree are ready to pick. ㄹ. Most of the information in the report was correct. ㅁ. Each of the twins has a different personality.
questions.why: ㄱ, ㄷ, ㄹ(information 단수 취급), ㅁ이 옳아 4개다. ㄴ은 receives가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Every star in the night sky look small. ㄴ. Some of the players on the bench were nervous. ㄷ. One of the rules of the game are simple. ㄹ. Most of the bread in the bakery is sold by noon. ㅁ. Each of the artists paint in a different style.
questions.why: ㄱ(looks), ㄷ(is), ㅁ(paints)이 틀려 3개다. ㄴ과 ㄹ은 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Half of the year is already gone. ㄴ. Each of the movies were about three hours long. ㄷ. Every problem has more than one answer. ㄹ. Some of the students in the gym was dancing. ㅁ. One of my favorite subjects is science.
questions.why: ㄱ(year 단수), ㄷ, ㅁ이 옳아 3개다. ㄴ은 was, ㄹ은 were가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. Most of the paint on the wall was dry. ㄴ. Every farmer in this area grow rice. ㄷ. One of the busiest airports in the world is in Atlanta. ㄹ. Each of the students hands in homework on Friday. ㅁ. Some of the birds in the park stay there all winter.
questions.why: ㄱ(paint 단수 취급), ㄷ, ㄹ, ㅁ이 옳아 4개다. ㄴ은 grows가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 틀린 것은?
choices: One of the problems with plastic bags <u>is</u> that they last for hundreds of years.
Most of the plastic in the ocean <u>comes</u> from land.
Each of us <u>have</u> to reduce plastic waste.
Some of the sea animals <u>eat</u> plastic by mistake.
questions.why: 「each of+복수대명사」도 each가 주어이므로 has to가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 동사의 형태가 틀린 것은?
choices: Each of the seasons in Korea <u>has</u> its own beauty.
Most of the rain <u>falls</u> in summer.
Every mountain near Seoul <u>is</u> crowded on weekends.
Some of the leaves <u>turns</u> red in October.
Half of the year <u>feels</u> like winter to me.
questions.why: some of 뒤의 leaves가 복수이므로 turn이 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 잘못된 것을 고르시오.
choices: One of the oldest buildings in town <u>is</u> the library.
Every book on the second floor <u>is</u> free to borrow.
Some of the computers there <u>are</u> quite slow.
Most of the space <u>is</u> used for reading rooms.
Each of the study rooms <u>hold</u> six people.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 holds가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것을 고르면?
choices: Every runner in the marathon <u>were</u> given a number.
One of the runners <u>was</u> over seventy years old.
Most of the road <u>was</u> closed to cars.
Some of the fans <u>were</u> holding signs.
Each of the water stations <u>was</u> two kilometers apart.
questions.why: every+단수명사(runner)는 단수 취급하므로 was가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 동사 중 수 일치가 틀린 것은?
choices: Most of the food at the festival <u>was</u> sold out by six.
Each of the food trucks <u>were</u> run by local cooks.
Every ticket for the night concert <u>was</u> gone.
Some of the singers <u>were</u> high school students.
One of the stages <u>was</u> near the river.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 was가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 고쳐 써야 하는 것은?
choices: One of the best things about fall <u>is</u> the cool weather.
Every family in my building <u>enjoys</u> the roof garden.
Some of the flowers there <u>blooms</u> until November.
Most of the soil <u>is</u> kept wet by the rain.
Each of the pots <u>has</u> a name tag on it.
questions.why: some of 뒤의 flowers가 복수이므로 bloom으로 고쳐야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 옳지 않은 것을 고르시오.
choices: Each of the club members <u>pays</u> 5,000 won a month.
Most of the money <u>goes</u> to buying books.
Every meeting <u>starts</u> with a short quiz.
One of the members always <u>bring</u> cookies.
Some of the books <u>are</u> in English.
questions.why: 「one of+복수명사」의 주어는 one이므로 brings가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 동사가 어색한 것은?
choices: About half of the students in the survey <u>sleep</u> less than seven hours.
Every doctor <u>says</u> that sleep is important.
Some of the students <u>do</u> homework late at night.
Most of their tiredness <u>comes</u> from using phones in bed.
Each of the classes <u>start</u> at 8:30 in the morning.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 starts가 되어야 한다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Every city in the world (A)(has / have) its own smell. Most of the smells (B)(comes / come) from food and trees. One of the strongest smells in Seoul (C)(is / are) the smell of street food.
questions.why: (A) every+단수명사→has, (B) smells가 복수→come, (C) one이 주어→is.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Each of the planets (A)(moves / move) around the sun. Some of the planets (B)(has / have) many moons. About 70 percent of the Earth's surface (C)(is / are) water.
questions.why: (A) each가 주어→moves, (B) planets가 복수→have, (C) surface가 단수→is.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? One of my favorite writers (A)(is / are) from England. Every story she writes (B)(become / becomes) popular. Most of her books (C)(was / were) made into movies.
questions.why: (A) one이 주어→is, (B) every+단수명사→becomes, (C) books가 복수→were.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Half of the students in our school (A)(brings / bring) smartphones to class. Each of the classrooms (B)(has / have) a phone box. Every phone (C)(is / are) kept there until the last class.
questions.why: (A) students가 복수→bring, (B) each가 주어→has, (C) every+단수명사→is.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Most of the water on the Earth (A)(is / are) salt water. One of the biggest problems today (B)(is / are) the lack of clean water. Each of us (C)(needs / need) to save water at home.
questions.why: (A) water는 셀 수 없는 명사→is, (B) one이 주어→is, (C) each가 주어→needs.

questions.stem: 글의 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 것끼리 짝지은 것은? Every animal in the desert (A)(has / have) its own way to survive. Some of the animals (B)(sleeps / sleep) during the day. One of them, the desert fox, (C)(hunts / hunt) at night.
questions.why: (A) every+단수명사→has, (B) animals가 복수→sleep, (C) one이 주어→hunts.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장으로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: Each of the answers were checked twice by the teacher.
One of the things I want to learn is how to swim.
Every students who joins the club gets a T-shirt.
Some of the advice my grandmother gives are old but useful.
Most of the students who took the test says it was easy.
questions.why: 주어가 one이므로 단수동사 is를 쓴 ②가 옳다. ①은 was, ③은 every student, ④는 advice가 단수 취급이라 is, ⑤는 say가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 맞는 문장을 고르시오.
choices: One of the boys who play soccer with me are my cousin.
Every house that have a red roof belongs to the company.
Each of the girls sing in the school choir.
Most of the trees that were planted last year are growing well.
Half of the stores in the mall closes early on Sundays.
questions.why: most of 뒤의 trees(복수)에 are를 맞춘 ④가 옳다. ①은 문장의 동사가 is, ②는 관계사절의 동사가 has, ③은 sings, ⑤는 close가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 수 일치가 옳은 문장은?
choices: About 60 percent of the human body is water.
Each of the problems on the board were solved by Mina.
Every one of the singers have practiced for months.
Some of the bread that I bought yesterday were too hard.
One of the fastest animals on land are the cheetah.
questions.why: percent of 뒤의 body가 단수이므로 is를 쓴 ①이 옳다. ②는 was, ③은 has, ④는 bread가 단수 취급이라 was, ⑤는 is가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르면?
choices: One of the paintings that were stolen was found in Paris.
Some of the questions that he asked were quite hard.
Every child who visit the museum gets a free gift.
Most of the rice that we eat is grown in Korea.
Each of the players who won a medal was interviewed.
questions.why: 관계사절의 선행사가 child(단수)이므로 visit이 아니라 visits가 되어야 한다. ①은 관계사절의 were(선행사 paintings)와 문장의 was(주어 one)가 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 수 일치가 틀린 문장은?
choices: Every teacher in our school knows my name.
One of the reasons I like winter is the food.
Some of the snow on the mountain never melts.
Each of the rooms in the palace was decorated with gold.
Half of the people in the survey wants a four-day school week.
questions.why: half of 뒤의 people이 복수이므로 want가 되어야 한다. ③은 snow가 셀 수 없는 명사라 melts가 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르시오.
choices: Every movie in this series has a happy ending.
Most of the students in my class thinks that the test was unfair.
One of the shops that sell old books is near my house.
Some of the money was used to buy flowers.
Each of the questions in part two was worth ten points.
questions.why: most of 뒤의 students가 복수이므로 think가 되어야 한다. ③은 관계사절의 sell(선행사 shops)과 문장의 is(주어 one)가 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: '그 학생들 각각은 자신만의 사물함을 가지고 있다.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
choices: Each of the students have his or her own locker.
Each of the student has his or her own locker.
Each of the students has his or her own locker.
Each student have his or her own locker.
Each of students has their own locker.
questions.why: 「each of the+복수명사」+단수동사(has)인 ③이 옳다. ①④는 동사, ②는 명사의 수가 틀렸고 ⑤는 the가 빠졌다.

questions.stem: '그 돈의 대부분은 가난한 아이들을 돕는 데 쓰인다.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
choices: Most of the money is used to help poor children.
Most of the money are used to help poor children.
Most of money is use to help poor children.
Most of the moneys are used to help poor children.
Most of the money is used to helping poor children.
questions.why: money는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 단수동사 is를 쓰고 「be used to+동사원형」으로 쓴 ①이 옳다.

questions.stem: '모든 나라는 지켜야 할 자신만의 규칙이 있다.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
choices: Every country have its own rules to follow.
Every countries has its own rules to follow.
Every countries have their own rules to follow.
Every of the countries has its own rules to follow.
Every country has its own rules to follow.
questions.why: every+단수명사+단수동사(has)인 ⑤가 옳다. every 뒤에는 복수명사나 of를 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: '우리 반 학생들 중 절반이 그 동아리에 가입하기를 원한다.'를 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
choices: Half of the students in my class wants to join the club.
Half of the students in my class want to join the club.
Half of the student in my class want to join the club.
The half of students in my class wants to join the club.
Half of the students in my class are want to join the club.
questions.why: half of 뒤의 students(복수)에 맞춰 want를 쓴 ②가 옳다. ①은 동사의 수, ③은 명사의 수가 틀렸다.

questions.stem: One of the most difficult things about learning a language ____ speaking in front of others.
questions.why: 주어는 one(단수)이므로 is. of 뒤의 things에 속으면 안 된다.

questions.stem: Every scientist who studies the ocean ____ that it is getting warmer.
questions.why: 주어는 every scientist(단수)이므로 knows. who studies는 수식하는 관계사절이다.

questions.stem: Some of the photos that were taken at the festival ____ now on the school website.
questions.why: some of 뒤의 photos가 복수이고 now가 있으므로 현재형 복수동사 are.

questions.stem: Two thirds of the students in my class ____ to have the sports day in May.
questions.why: 분수 표현(two thirds of) 뒤의 students가 복수이므로 want.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 Every로 시작하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 다시 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): All the students in my class are kind.
questions.answer: Every student in my class is kind.
questions.why: every 뒤에는 단수명사(student)를 쓰고 동사도 단수형 is로 바꾼다.
alt: Every student in my class is kind

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 Each of로 시작하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 다시 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): All the rooms in the hotel are clean.
questions.answer: Each of the rooms in the hotel is clean.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 명사는 복수(rooms)로 두되 동사는 단수형 is로 쓴다.
alt: Each of the rooms in the hotel is clean

questions.stem: 다음 단어들을 모두 한 번씩만 사용하여 어법에 맞는 문장을 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): (of / one / the / questions / was / very / easy)
questions.answer: One of the questions was very easy.
questions.why: 「one of+복수명사」가 주어일 때 동사는 단수형 was를 쓴다.
alt: One of the questions was very easy

questions.stem: 다음 단어들을 모두 한 번씩만 사용하여 어법에 맞는 문장을 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): (every / has / child / a / dream)
questions.why: every+단수명사(child)가 주어이므로 단수동사 has를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 단어들을 모두 한 번씩만 사용하여 어법에 맞는 문장을 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): (most / of / the / milk / is / gone)
questions.answer: Most of the milk is gone.
questions.why: milk는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 most of 뒤에서도 단수동사 is를 쓴다.
alt: Most of the milk is gone

questions.stem: 다음 단어들을 모두 한 번씩만 사용하여 어법에 맞는 문장을 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): (each / of / the / players / wears / a / cap)
questions.answer: Each of the players wears a cap.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」가 주어일 때 동사는 단수형 wears를 쓴다.
alt: Each of the players wears a cap

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 Each student로 시작하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 다시 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): Every student in our school learns two languages.
questions.answer: Each student in our school learns two languages.
questions.why: each+단수명사도 every+단수명사처럼 단수 취급하므로 동사 learns는 그대로 둔다.
alt: Each student in our school learns two languages

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 Half of the apples로 시작하여 같은 의미의 문장으로 다시 쓰시오. (문장 부호 포함): Fifty percent of the apples in the box are red.
questions.answer: Half of the apples in the box are red.
questions.why: fifty percent of = half of이며, of 뒤의 apples가 복수이므로 are를 그대로 쓴다.
alt: Half of the apples in the box are red

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): One of the students who joined the contest <u>were</u> my sister.
questions.why: 문장의 주어는 one(단수)이므로 were가 아니라 was를 쓴다. who joined의 주어는 students이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): Every mountain that I have climbed <u>have</u> a story.
questions.why: 문장의 주어는 every mountain(단수)이므로 has를 쓴다. that I have climbed는 수식하는 관계사절이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): Each of the letters he sent me <u>were</u> full of jokes.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 was를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): Most of the students who saw the movie <u>says</u> it was great.
questions.why: most of 뒤의 students가 복수이므로 say를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): Some of the information in this book <u>are</u> out of date.
questions.why: information은 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 some of 뒤에서도 단수동사 is를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (시제는 유지할 것): About 80 percent of the messages I get <u>is</u> from my club members.
questions.why: percent of 뒤의 messages가 복수이므로 are를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 어법에 맞게 현재시제로 쓰시오: One of the things that make me happy ____ (be) my dog.
questions.why: 문장의 주어는 one(단수)이므로 is. that make의 주어는 things(복수)이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 어법에 맞게 현재시제로 쓰시오: Every window in the tall building ____ (be) cleaned once a month.
questions.why: every+단수명사(window)는 단수 취급하므로 is.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 어법에 맞게 현재시제로 쓰시오: Each of the countries at the Olympics ____ (send) its best players.
questions.why: 「each of+복수명사」는 단수 취급하므로 sends.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 동사를 어법에 맞게 현재시제로 쓰시오: Most of the rice that Koreans eat ____ (come) from Korean farms.
questions.why: rice는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 most of 뒤에서도 단수동사 comes를 쓴다.
